description: This Java class implements a custom JWT deserializer that converts JSON strings into Java objects (such as Maps and Lists) using the JJWT library and custom Json processing classes.

classes.name: JjwtDeserializer
classes.description: A singleton class implementing JWT deserialization from JSON strings to Java objects using the JJWT library.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of JjwtDeserializer.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array containing JSON data into a Java object, throwing DeserializationException on error.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a Java object using JsonFactory.

methods.name: toJavaMap
methods.description: Converts a JsonObject into a Java Map<String, Object>.

methods.name: toJavaList
methods.description: Converts a JsonArray into a List<Object>.

methods.name: toJavaObject
methods.description: Recursively converts a JsonValue into its corresponding Java object.
